title: AQ Podcast | María Corina Machado Is Back. Now What?
gist: This is a podcast promo page, not a transcript. After María Corina Machado's Oct. 25, 2026 return to Venezuela, it notes that Delcy Rodríguez's interim government has made concessions (amnesty, prisoner releases, U.S.-backed talks), but security officials remain in place, more than 300 political prisoners are still held, and no election date is set.

insights.claim: Opposition leader and Nobel Peace Prize laureate María Corina Machado returned to Venezuela on October 25, 2026, raising hopes of a faster return to democracy.
insights.speaker: Americas Quarterly
insights.so_what: Machado's presence raises pressure for an election timetable, a key input for Venezuela sanctions and oil-deal risk.
insights.locator: Since María Corina Machado returned to

insights.claim: Since Nicolás Maduro's capture in January 2026, Delcy Rodríguez's interim government has passed an amnesty law, released hundreds of political prisoners, and joined U.S.-backed talks with part of the opposition.
insights.speaker: Americas Quarterly
insights.so_what: There is partial liberalization under U.S.-backed talks, but the transition is still controlled by holdovers from the old regime.
insights.locator: Since María Corina Machado returned to

insights.claim: Much of Venezuela's old system is still standing: many officials who ran the regime's security apparatus remain in their posts, Foro Penal counts more than 300 political prisoners, and no presidential election date has been set.
insights.speaker: Americas Quarterly
insights.so_what: Without an election date or a security-sector overhaul, the political risk to Venezuelan assets and oil deals stays elevated.
insights.quote: Foro Penal counts more than 300 political prisoners, and there is still no date for a presidential election

insights.claim: The episode, hosted by Brian Winter with Foro Penal director Alfredo Romero, asks what must happen before Venezuelans can vote in a credible election. The page gives no answers from the conversation itself.
insights.speaker: Americas Quarterly
insights.so_what: Preconditions for a credible election are the metric to track. This page is only a podcast teaser.
